title: The Social Atelier Location and Layout Details
excerpt: Explore The Social Atelier location and layout details. Compare our curated Lekki Phase 1 spaces, pricing, and top alternatives for your next shoot.
body:
Proven Production Value: The Social Atelier by the Numbers

High-end production should not require weeks of construction or an astronomical budget. Our premier studio in Lekki, Lagos delivers immediately camera-ready, European-inspired environments, complete with backup power and on-site parking, so that your project or intimate event runs flawlessly from the first minute.

Wide hero image of the studio exterior and entrance in Lekki, Lagos, shot in daylight, with the signage and on-site parking visible.

  • 8 individually designed spaces: Curated rooms and event settings, each camera-ready, under one roof in Lekki.

  • 0 hours of set design: No extra decoration time is required to make your visual production look exceptional.

  • From NGN 50,000 per hour: Transparent, published rates per space, from The Archway at NGN 50,000 to The Piano Room at NGN 150,000 per hour.

  • 2, 4 and 8-hour blocks: Bookings run Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, in two-hour, four-hour and full-day blocks.

  • Elevate your vision: Discuss your layout and capacity needs with our team →

The Social Atelier at a Glance

With rates beginning at NGN 50,000 per hour, premium content creation becomes genuinely accessible. Creators and brands gain immediate access to eight distinct settings, from photo and content studios to dedicated event spaces, designed to bypass the traditional hassle of location scouting.

What You Get

Details

Timeline

Curated Creative Spaces

Six European-inspired photo and content studios: Maison Paris, The Creperie, The Archway, The Piano Room, Nue Ville and Bain & Bubbles. Zero extra set design required.

Hourly, from NGN 50,000 to NGN 150,000 per hour

Podcast Studios

Controlled, styled interiors used for podcast, interview and talk-show recording, with backdrops built for video-first shows.

Hourly, from NGN 50,000 per hour

Intimate Event Venues

Lauren Fair (indoor) and Miguel & Moss Garden (outdoor gazebo) for bridal showers, birthdays, private dinners and launches.

Lauren Fair from NGN 400,000 per hour; Miguel & Moss Garden from NGN 250,000 per hour

Technical Amenities & Power

Backup power throughout your session, on-site parking, elegant lighting options, sound system and a small kitchenette in Lauren Fair.

Available throughout booking duration

Production Gear

Lighting is available on site. Cameras, lenses and audio equipment are not provided; clients bring their own.

Available throughout booking duration

Where We Shine

We bridge the gap between raw space and finished product by offering fully realised, highly aesthetic backdrops. From backup power to meticulously curated props, our facility is engineered to keep your crew focused entirely on capturing the exceptional frame. Browse the full collection of spaces before you reserve.

  • Book your session: Contact our team to discuss your layout needs, guest capacity, or to secure your booking → Contact us

Immediately Camera-Ready, European-Inspired Rooms

Our spaces require zero extra set design to look exceptional on camera. Content creator Marcus Chen filmed an entire season of his YouTube series here without bringing external decor.

Eight Distinct Creative Spaces Under One Lekki Roof

Maison Paris recreates a vintage Parisian waiting lounge. The Archway is a dome-like hallway drawn from iconic European architecture. Nue Ville offers minimalist, nude-toned simplicity, while The Piano Room delivers an opulent ballroom with grand piano and chandelier. Booking one address replaces booking several.

A four-panel grid showing each set in turn: Maison Paris, The Archway, Nue Ville and The Piano Room, so readers can compare the looks at a glance.

Studios Suited to Video Podcasts and Interviews

Podcast and interview recording is one of the primary uses of our studios. The rooms provide enclosed, softly furnished interiors and finished backdrops, which matter greatly for video-first shows. Bring your own microphones and recorders; the visual environment is already resolved.

Two guests seated across from each other mid-conversation, with a camera framing the finished backdrop behind them.

Elevated Venues for Intimate Gatherings

Lauren Fair is our dedicated event space, with flexible seating arrangements, elegant lighting options, a sound system, a small kitchenette and customisable decor elements. Miguel & Moss Garden, a flower-adorned gazebo, hosts outdoor celebrations. Guest numbers are confirmed per event with our team, since the layout adapts to each format.

Side-by-side pairing of Lauren Fair dressed for a seated evening event and the Miguel & Moss Garden gazebo in bloom during the day.

Uninterrupted Production with Backup Power and On-Site Parking

Our Lekki facility runs on backup power, so a grid interruption does not cost you booked hours. On-site parking is available for arriving crews and guests, and we confirm vehicle allocation with you at the point of booking.

Professional Lighting On Site, Cameras Supplied by You

Lighting is available in-house, which removes the heaviest item from your transport list. Cameras, lenses and audio gear remain your responsibility, keeping your rate honest and your kit familiar.

Built for Creators and Brands at Every Production Scale

Our environments scale to match the ambitions of diverse creative projects. Whether you are recording a multi-microphone podcast, shooting a high-fashion editorial campaign, or hosting an intimate bridal shower, these spaces adapt to your brand aesthetic.

  • Ready to elevate your production? Contact our team to discuss layout or reserve your space → Contact us

Editorial Photographers and Campaign Directors

For established visual artists who need a premium, European-inspired backdrop in Lekki, we provide fully curated, camera-ready rooms that require zero extra set design.

YouTube Producers and Social Media Creators

Our versatile spaces allow creators to shoot several distinct setups in a single day, under one roof, saving hours of production time.

Professional Podcasters and Talk Show Hosts

Our studio interiors offer composed, aesthetically sophisticated recording environments built for modern digital talk shows.

Private Event Hosts and Celebrants

Lauren Fair and Miguel & Moss Garden are beautifully designed venues that elevate the guest experience for bridal showers and milestone birthdays.

Brand Managers and PR Agencies

Our Lekki location provides a highly curated backdrop for product launches, media previews and private brand dinners.

Creative Directors and Stylists

A collective of eight distinct spaces ensures your artistry thrives without the logistical headache of multiple venue bookings. Read more about our vision on the about page.

How It Works

Securing your studio time is a streamlined, three-step process built for busy production schedules.

Step 01: Select Your Space and Date

Choose your room and preferred date on the booking page, then select a two-hour, four-hour or full-day block within our Tuesday to Sunday hours.

Step 02: Secure Your Booking and Gear

We confirm your reservation over WhatsApp and agree any lighting requirements in advance. Client must supply: cameras, lenses and audio equipment.

Step 03: Arrive and Create

Arrive at our Lekki studio, where our team welcomes you into a fully curated, camera-ready room. Elapsed time: your booked hours. Complete when your session ends. Client must supply: your cameras, talent and creative energy.

Results

By bypassing setup delays and construction timelines, clients move immediately from arrival to active filming, capturing more finished content per booked hour.

1. Private celebrations hosted without additional decor spend

Hosts who would otherwise style a raw event hall arrive at Lauren Fair to find flexible seating, elegant lighting and curated decor elements already in place.

2. Video podcasts recorded without technical setup delays

Producers of video-first shows use our finished interiors as a permanent set, removing the recurring work of dressing a temporary room for each episode.

Pricing and Engagement Options

We publish straightforward hourly rates so that you book exactly the time your project requires, with no hidden fees.

Curated Creative Spaces

Best for: Photoshoots, editorial campaigns and social content.

What is included: Access to a selected European-inspired, camera-ready room, with lighting available on site.

Investment (per hour):

  • The Archway: NGN 50,000

  • The Creperie: NGN 75,000

  • Maison Paris: NGN 80,000

  • Nue Ville: NGN 90,000

  • Bain & Bubbles: NGN 95,000

  • The Piano Room: NGN 150,000

Podcast Studios

Best for: Recording audio and video podcasts or talk shows.

What is included: A styled, enclosed studio interior with finished backdrops.

Investment: From NGN 50,000 per hour, depending on the room.

Intimate Event Venues

Best for: Birthdays, bridal showers, launches and private dinners.

What is included: Flexible seating, elegant lighting and a sound system, plus a kitchenette (Lauren Fair) or an outdoor gazebo (Miguel & Moss Garden).

Investment (per hour):

  • Lauren Fair: from NGN 400,000

  • Miguel & Moss Garden: from NGN 250,000

What Changes the Price

Your total investment is driven by the specific room selected, the duration booked (two hours, four hours or a full eight-hour day), and whether your project requires a multi-camera or event setup.

What Is Not Included

Cameras, lenses, audio equipment, external production crew and catering are not included. Event spaces are available by appointment rather than on the standard studio calendar.

Don't Take Our Word for It

"I filmed an entire season of my YouTube series at The Social Atelier. The aesthetics are unmatched and it saved me countless hours in set design. My subscribers constantly ask about the beautiful backgrounds!" Marcus Chen, Content Creator. For more stories from the studio, read our journal and its opening entry.

FAQs About The Social Atelier

How much does booking a space at The Social Atelier cost? Rates begin at NGN 50,000 per hour for The Archway and rise to NGN 150,000 per hour for The Piano Room, depending on the space selected. Event spaces are priced from NGN 250,000 per hour. Every rate includes a curated, camera-ready room with no additional set design cost.

What does the booking process look like? Select your space, date and duration on our booking page. Bookings run Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, in two-hour, four-hour and full-day (eight-hour) blocks, and we confirm your reservation over WhatsApp on +234 903 118 9697.

Does The Social Atelier provide lighting and camera gear, or do I bring my own? Lighting is available on site. Cameras, lenses and audio equipment are not provided, so please bring your own. Props and set decoration are unnecessary, as every room is pre-styled.

Is The Social Atelier good for recording a podcast? Yes. Podcast and interview recording is one of the principal uses of our studios, which offer enclosed, softly furnished interiors and finished backdrops suited to video-first shows. Presenters supply their own microphones and recorders.

Why pay for a curated space instead of setting up DIY props? Sourcing, purchasing, transporting and storing premium props for a basic studio quickly exceeds an hourly rate, and it consumes the hours you intended to spend filming. Our rooms are exceptional on camera the moment you walk in.

Where exactly is The Social Atelier, and is there parking and backup power? The Social Atelier is located in Lekki, Lagos, Nigeria. On-site parking is available, and backup power runs throughout your session so that a grid interruption does not cost you booked hours.

Can I host a bridal shower or birthday, and what is the guest capacity? Yes. Lauren Fair hosts intimate celebrations indoors with flexible seating, elegant lighting, a sound system and a small kitchenette, while Miguel & Moss Garden hosts outdoor gatherings. Because the layout adapts to each format, we confirm exact guest numbers with you when you enquire.

How do I reserve a space? Contact our team to discuss your layout needs, guest capacity or preferred date.
author: Ada Nwachukwu
